content.title: Pirates vs. Mets: Prediction, Lineups, How to Watch (3/28/26)
content.text: The Pittsburgh Pirates (0–1) and the New York Mets (1–0) continue their Opening Week series this afternoon at Citi Field. The Mets opened their 2026 season with an emphatic 11–7 win over the Pirates, fueled by a five-run first inning. New York did the unthinkable: chasing reigning NL Cy Young winner Paul Skenes after just two outs, capitalizing on early mistakes and defensive miscues by Oneil Cruz to build a commanding lead. The Pirates got on board first with Brandon Lowe hitting a two-run homer in the first off Freddy Peralta, who was making his debut for the Mets. But the Mets responded immediately in the bottom of the inning, with Brett Baty delivering a key bases-clearing triple in the opening frame. Francisco Alvarez and rookie Carson Benge added home runs in the sixth to keep the pressure on. Peralta earned the win, striking out seven over five innings despite allowing four runs. Mitch Keller gets the ball for Pittsburgh this afternoon, coming off a decent 2025 campaign, finishing with a 4.19 ERA and a 6-15 record reflective of poor run support. David Peterson takes the mound for the Amazins’, looking to rebound from a 2025 season in which he regressed from a stellar 2024. Peterson began the season strong, with a pre-All-Star break ERA of 3.06, but like other Mets veterans in the bullpen, his season fell apart in the second half, with a post-break ERA of 6.34. The Mets have the edge here in a tight game as several New York bats have had success against Keller. Both Baty and Juan Soto are batting over .400 against him with a homer each. Prediction: New York Mets 6, Pittsburgh Pirates 4 Starting Lineups Pittsburgh Pirates Jared Triolo — SS Ryan O’Hearn — 1B Bryan Reynolds — LF Marcell Ozuna — DH Nick Gonzales — 3B Brandon Lowe — 2B Nick Yorke — RF Joey Bart — C Jake Mangum — CF Starting Pitcher: Mitch Keller — RHP New York Mets Francisco Lindor — SS Juan Soto — LF Bo Bichette — 3B Jorge Polanco — 1B Luis Robert Jr. — CF Brett Baty — DH Marcus Semien — 2B Carson Benge — RF Francisco Alvarez — C Starting Pitcher: David Peterson — LHP How to Watch Pirates vs. Mets First pitch is scheduled for 4:10 PM Eastern at Citi Field in Flushing, Queens. The game airs live locally on SNY and SportsNet Pittsburgh, and streams on MLB.TV for out-of-market audiences. Fans in the New York City area can access the SNY stream through MLB using a participating cable, satellite, or Hulu + Live TV subscription.
